title: Satmar Matriarch Passes Away
body: Bnei Brak mourns the petirah of Mrs. Esther Rachel Yaakobovitz, 103, widow of prominent Satmar Rabbi Bentzion Yaakobovitz, a key figure in the city's Satmar housing complex.

title: Frum Jew Wins Big
body: A frum Jew claimed the NY Lottery's "$10,000 a Week for Life" jackpot, opting for a single cash payout of $4,372,060 after taxes. The winning ticket was sold at the NO7 Grocery on 18th Avenue.

title: Antisemitic Threats Made Public
body: Federal prosecutors charged 36-year-old Elijah Alexander King with making violent antisemitic threats under the alias "Billy Badass". Authorities say King's outburst could lead to a decade-long prison sentence.
